name: Le Petit Brevet
description: A demanding weekend brevet through the steep hills, quiet roads and hidden bays of Banks Peninsula.
text1: First held in 2010, Le Petit Brevet is a challenging bikepacking event through the spectacular hills and bays of Banks Peninsula. Riders meet at Hansen Park for a short briefing before heading into the peninsula under their own steam.

Several courses have been used over the years, including the 200 km Nice Weekend Out, the 300 km Original-ish and a longer route visiting all the peninsula’s bays. This page follows the 300 km Original-ish course. The route may change between editions, so check the latest information from Great Kiwi Gravel before setting out.
text2: Akaroa and Little River are the main opportunities for food and accommodation, but services can be limited—particularly outside normal opening hours. Carry plenty of water, bring enough food for the remote sections and make sure your bike has suitably low gearing.
text3: Do not underestimate the climbing or the surface changes. Steep peninsula roads, exposed ridges, gates, grass or farm-track sections and potentially muddy weather can make the ride much slower than the distance suggests. Confirm the current year's GPX and access conditions with Great Kiwi Gravel before setting out, particularly as new routes are planned.
